characters.description: A human-Draugr cultivator entering the Perennial Vastness to pursue a difficult cosmic-core plan. He must gather enough mana to make the design viable while finding Ogras and Catheya.
characters.name: Zac

characters.description: The identity Zac uses in his dealings with the Undead Empire. Its agreement with him is complicated by rival factions, Catheya's manipulated departure, and agents sent into the Perennial Vastness to find either of them.
characters.name: Arcaz Umbrizi

characters.description: Zac's demon companion and a shadow cultivator. He is a trusted but covert ally whose abilities and judgment complement Zac's direct approach.
characters.name: Ogras

characters.description: A Draugr cultivator close to Zac, with strengths in ice, formations, and death-attuned environments.
characters.name: Catheya

characters.description: A newly created Perennial Vastness guide linked to Zac through a wristband. She was assigned because his affinities do not fit ordinary categories, and her own continued existence depends on how well he performs.
characters.name: Null

characters.description: One of the Perennial Vastness's oldest disciples and a cultivator nearing supremacy. He intervenes during Zac's orientation and recognizes that Zac's void understanding carries a connection to the Left Imperial Palace.
characters.name: Engo

characters.description: A Radiant Temple numerologist who has waited for Zac in the Perennial Vastness. He knows Zac's human and Draugr identities are connected and seeks an exchange concerning the Left Imperial Palace.
characters.name: Radiant Temple Numerologist

characters.description: A First Imperial Heaven princess who uses covert watchers and a coalition to locate Left Imperial Palace seal bearers. After an observer identifies Zac as a Flame Bearer, she orders an investigation and plans to seize the connected fate.
characters.name: Imperial Princess

characters.description: A barbarian cultivator who meets Zac after the Quarry expedition and asks to join him on a future war-zone venture. He accepts that they will compete for any treasure they find.
characters.name: Kruta

characters.description: A feared senior cultivator from the Empyrean Throne who arrives aboard the Thousand Flame Galley to take custody of Kruta after his return home.
characters.name: Empyrean Throne Disciple

characters.description: An orc supremacy associated with the Thousand Flame vessel. She accepts Kruta as her sole disciple and sets two years of training before deciding whether he can continue toward the junior event.
characters.name: Tain Supremacy

characters.description: A companion of Zac's who is regaining her former strength by consuming energy. The process appears to reduce her already limited lifespan.
characters.name: Vivi

characters.description: An Imperial leader commanding Deathsworn soldiers and mages through a powerful war array. She traps Zac and Kruta in the Stand of Saeward, declaring that the Left Imperial Palace fate belongs to her Empire rather than to Zac.
characters.name: Valsa Planur

characters.description: The warlord associated with the Stand of Saeward. Escalating activity there prompts Kruta to recruit Zac for an expedition.
characters.name: Saeward

characters.description: Zac's second tool spirit. She briefly seals a mage's fate and interrupts his escape, but the effort damages her soul and leaves her facing years of recovery.
characters.name: Alea

characters.description: The avatar of the Perennial Vastness. He appears when Valsa Planur's father attacks the realm after her death, intervening to defend the Vastness's neutrality and prevent the extraction of useful trial memories.
characters.name: Sendor

characters.description: A small, sign-speaking toad with ancient power who appears as the Calamity Mountain collapses. She and a female companion intervene against the awakened dream beast and help the newborn mountain spirit escape.
characters.name: Esmeralda

characters.description: Esmeralda's interpreter and the sponsor of a proposed palace partnership. She approaches Zac with an arrangement that would allow the exceptional thief to accompany him into the Left Imperial Palace.
characters.name: Lova

characters.description: A powerful fire cultivator and an important external contact of Zac's. The rare drops she previously gave him remain valuable safeguards during the dangerous breakthroughs he intends to attempt.
characters.name: Iz Tayn

characters.description: A guide associated with a Buddhist Sangha who shares a strong karmic link with Zac. Her place in the Sangha and the unresolved obligation surrounding Three Virtues keep that connection important.
characters.name: Thea

characters.description: A powerful Buddhist cultivator and the master of Thea's abbot. His earlier role as a benefactor leaves an unresolved obligation connected to Thea and the Sangha.
characters.name: Three Virtues

characters.description: Zac's absent mother and a protector tied to the concealment surrounding him.
characters.name: Leandra

characters.description: An ally Zac has not yet recovered. She does not accompany the Perennial Vastness expedition, and the need to rescue her remains one of his major obligations beyond his immediate breakthrough.
characters.name: Kenzie

characters.description: Zac's disciple and a bearer of a Radiant Court seal. She is absent while pursuing her own court path, but her place among the scattered seal bearers keeps her connected to Zac's future Ultum plans.
characters.name: Emily

characters.description: A concealed consciousness within a moss crystal in Zac's soul aperture. It emerges as a threat when his improvised life-and-death soul breakthrough damages the prison holding Creation and Oblivion remnants.
characters.name: Mossy

characters.description: Valsa Planur's supremacy father. Sensing his daughter's death, he attacks the Perennial Vastness and tries to recover her memories, threatening to expose the identity and fate of the opponent who killed her.
characters.name: Vastermal Planur
